findings.msg: Nonce does not appear to have sufficient entropy (calculated Shannon entropy is below the threshold). Section 5.2 of OID4VP 1.0 Final requires the nonce to be a "fresh, cryptographically random number with sufficient entropy"; OpenID4VP PR #722 (https://github.com/openid/OpenID4VP/pull/722/changes) recommends at least 128 bits.
